Day 16

May 07 2026

Shrimp spotted eating a molt. This is a good sign! I thought I had seen some molts the past few days but I wasn’t sure. This one is definitely a head. This is very exciting. I’ve been stressing out about my water parameters and cycling, so this successful molt is huge. It means the tank conditions are good enough for them and as long as I keep things stable they should all survive.

Next milestone is breeding…I want to see eggs….

The lobelia in the front has a leaf that is wilting
